arguments.content:
"""Line indentation."""

from __future__ import annotations


def indent(text: str, prefix: str, *, skip_blank: bool = False) -> str:
    """Add ``prefix`` to the start of every line of ``text``.

    Line endings (``\\n``, ``\\r\\n``) are preserved exactly, and no newline is
    added or removed.

    Args:
        text: Input text.
        prefix: String to put in front of each line.
        skip_blank: When true, lines that are empty or contain only whitespace
            are left unchanged (no prefix, and their own whitespace is kept).
            When false (the default), every line, including blank ones, is
            prefixed.

    Returns:
        The indented text.
    """
    if not skip_blank:
        return "".join(prefix + line for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True))

    result: list[str] = []
    for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
        # A line is blank if, after stripping its line ending, nothing but
        # whitespace remains. The line is returned unchanged in that case so
        # that its own whitespace and line ending are preserved.
        if not line.rstrip("\r\n").strip():
            result.append(line)
        else:
            result.append(prefix + line)
    return "".join(result)
